digestion.name: Digestion
digestion.desc: Your body digests the last meal and uses the energy at hand.

stabilization.name: Stabilisation
stabilization.desc: Insulin levels drop and your body switches to its reserves.

fatBurning.name: Fat burning
fatBurning.desc: Your body increasingly reaches for fat stores.

eating.name: Eating window
eating.desc: Eat calmly and well. Your next fast starts at {time}.

startSheet.title: When did you start fasting?
startSheet.description: Tell us when you had your last meal. We’ll count your fast from that moment.
startSheet.future: That time hasn’t come yet. Pick an earlier one.
startSheet.beforePrevious: Your previous fast ended {when}. Pick a later time.

endSheet.title: When did you end your fast?
endSheet.description: Enter the time of your first meal. We’ll save the fast length based on it.
endSheet.future: That time hasn’t come yet. Pick an earlier one.
endSheet.beforeStart: The end can’t be earlier than the start of the fast ({when}).

endConfirm.title: End your fast?
endConfirm.descriptionBelow: You’re still {missing} short of your {goal} h goal. You can end now or enter the time of your meal.
endConfirm.descriptionReached: {goal} h goal reached. Your fast will be saved to history.

welcome.title: Intermittent fasting, made simple.
welcome.lead: Fasting timer, phases, water and weight in one light app.
welcome.benefitNoAccountText: Your data stays on your phone.
welcome.benefitPwaText: Install it from your browser, no app store needed.
welcome.howToInstall: How do I install Posto on my phone?
welcome.legal: By using Posto, you accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

install.title: Install Posto
install.description: Posto is a PWA. You install it straight from your browser, no app store needed. Then you open it from your home screen like any other app.
install.alreadyInstalled: Posto is already installed on this device. Open it from your home screen.
install.iphone1Desc: Go to {url}. On newer iPhones this also works in Chrome.
install.iphone2Desc: The square with an arrow pointing up, on the bottom or top bar.
install.iphone3Desc: Can’t see it? Scroll down the list.
install.iphone4Desc: The Posto icon will appear on your home screen.
install.android2Desc: Three dots in the top right corner.
install.android3Desc: In some versions: “Add to Home screen”.
install.android4Desc: The Posto icon will appear on your home screen.
install.iphoneTip: On iPhone, end-of-fast notifications only work after you add Posto to your Home Screen.
install.androidTip: Chrome may offer to install the app by itself. Then just tap “Install” at the bottom of the screen.

protocol.title: Fasting protocol
protocol.description: Choose the rhythm that fits your day. You can change it at any time.
protocol.changeActiveTitle: Change the goal of your current fast?
protocol.changeActiveDescription: Your current fast has a {from} h goal. The new protocol aims for {to} h.
protocol.changeActiveYes: Yes, change the goal to {goal} h

history.title: History
history.streakDays: {count, plural, one {day in a row} other {days in a row}}
history.longestStreak: Longest streak: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
history.noCompleted: Completed fasts will show up here.
history.noCompletedActive: Your first fast is in progress. It will show up here once you end it.
history.emptyTitle: Your fasts will show up here
history.emptyText: After your first completed fast, we’ll calculate your streak, average and longest fast.

fastEdit.title: Edit fast
fastEdit.future: That time hasn’t come yet. Pick an earlier one.
fastEdit.endBeforeStart: The end must be later than the start.
fastEdit.invalid: Fill in the date and time.
fastEdit.deleteDescription: The fast will disappear from your history and statistics. This can’t be undone.

measurements.title: Progress
measurements.weightEmpty: Add your first measurement and we’ll show your weight change and 30-day trend.
measurements.noGoal: Set a goal weight in Settings to see your progress.

weightSheet.kgError: Enter a weight between {min} and {max} kg, e.g. 82.4.
weightSheet.deleteDescription: The {value} measurement will disappear from the list and the chart.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notifDenied: Your browser is blocking notifications from Posto. Allow them in your browser’s site settings, then turn the switch on again.
settings.notifIos: On iPhone, notifications only work after you add Posto to your Home Screen.
settings.notifLimits: Reminders appear while Posto is open or running in the background.
settings.installText: Quick access from your home screen.
